title.en: Upper abdominal pain and fever · 84-year-old man

summary.zh-CN: 84岁男性，上腹痛、发热十多天。从问诊、查体和资料核对开始，完成术前评估、手术安全核对，并在病例相关的参考解剖上亲手完成腹腔镜手术，再回看原报告的手术与随访。
summary.en: An 84-year-old man with upper abdominal pain and fever for more than ten days. Take the history, examine, review the records, assess perioperative risk, run the surgical safety checklist and perform the laparoscopic operation yourself on case-informed reference anatomy, then review the operation and follow-up the source reports.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 从CT报告准确识别并记录反位的左右位置。
learningOutcomes.en: Identify and document inverted organ laterality from the CT report.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 区分记录明确的事实、未记录信息和教学流程设定。
learningOutcomes.en: Distinguish documented facts, missing information and authored workflow settings.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 提出尊重解剖变异和患者合并症的团队术前讨论计划。
learningOutcomes.en: Formulate a team discussion plan addressing anatomical variation and comorbidities.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 应用术前核查与解剖辨认原则，并限定单例结局的外推范围。
learningOutcomes.en: Apply verification and anatomical-identification principles and bound inference from one case.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 依据东京指南2018区分胆囊结石、疑似与确诊急性胆囊炎，不把不完整证据当作确诊。
learningOutcomes.en: Distinguish gallstone disease from suspected and confirmed acute cholecystitis (Tokyo Guidelines 2018) without treating incomplete evidence as a diagnosis.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 在镜像解剖中选择并论证布孔、站位和牵拉方向。
learningOutcomes.en: Choose and justify ports, stance and traction directions in mirror-image anatomy.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 只有在关键安全视野的三项条件真实建立后才进行不可逆操作；无法建立时选择安全的替代策略。
learningOutcomes.en: Perform irreversible steps only once the three criteria of the critical view of safety truly hold; choose a safe alternative when they cannot.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 识别并处理术中出血、胆汁或结石溢出与胆管损伤，及时说出问题并求助。
learningOutcomes.en: Recognise and manage bleeding, bile or stone spillage and bile duct injury, say so aloud and call for help.

name.zh-CN: WHO 麻醉前核对（Sign In）并连接监护
name.en: WHO Sign In before induction, monitoring attached

response.zh-CN: 核对身份、手术、知情同意与部位：胆囊位于患者左侧（全内脏反位），右位心——心电图导联和除颤电极按镜像放置；过敏、气道与误吸风险、预计失血尚未记录，需当场确认。监护已连接。
response.en: Identity, procedure, consent and site checked: the gallbladder is on the patient's LEFT (situs inversus totalis); dextrocardia — ECG leads and defibrillator pads placed in mirror positions; allergies, airway and aspiration risk and expected blood loss are not recorded and are confirmed now. Monitoring attached.

name.zh-CN: 全身麻醉诱导与气管插管

response.zh-CN: 麻醉诱导完成，气管插管，机械通气。（教学步骤：不涉及药物剂量。）
response.en: Anaesthesia induced; intubated and ventilated. (Teaching step: no drug doses are modelled.)

harm.zh-CN: 未完成麻醉前核对就诱导：过敏、气道和部位风险未经团队确认。
harm.en: Induction before the Sign In: allergy, airway and site risks were not confirmed by the team.

name.zh-CN: WHO 切皮前暂停核对（Time Out）

response.zh-CN: 团队确认：患者、手术为腹腔镜胆囊切除、病变在患者左侧；术者讲解预计关键步骤（镜像解剖、关键安全视野后才夹闭）、抗菌药与影像已就位；如解剖不清将暂停、求助或改变术式。
response.en: The team confirms the patient, a laparoscopic cholecystectomy and the left-sided pathology; the surgeon states the critical steps (mirror-image anatomy, nothing clipped before the critical view of safety), antibiotics and imaging are ready; if the anatomy is unclear the team will stop, call for help or change approach.

harm.zh-CN: 麻醉诱导前就进行切皮前核对，顺序不对：已记录为无效，手术仍未开始，诱导后需重新核对。
harm.en: A Time Out before anaesthesia is out of order: recorded as invalid; the operation stays locked until a Time Out after induction.

response.en: The procedure performed, instrument and swab counts, specimen labelling and concerns for recovery (including any intra-operative complication) are confirmed and handed over.

harm.zh-CN: 手术尚未结束就做离室核对：已记录为无效，手术结束后需重新核对。
harm.en: Sign Out before the operation has ended: recorded as invalid; repeat it once the operation has ended.

name.en: Hand over in the recovery room

response.zh-CN: 交接：84岁，慢阻肺，既往脑梗死，全内脏反位；实施的手术和术中情况；需观察的问题。
response.en: Handover: 84 years, COPD, previous stroke, situs inversus totalis; the operation done and anything that happened; what to watch.

name.zh-CN: 结束模拟，打开原报告的手术、病理与随访记录
name.en: End the simulation and open the reported operation, histology and follow-up

response.zh-CN: 以下为原报告记载的真实经过；模拟中的操作不改变它。
response.en: What follows is what the source reports; nothing done in the simulation changes it.

harm.zh-CN: 术后观察要点尚未讨论。
harm.en: Postoperative priorities have not been discussed yet.

title.zh-CN: 核实症状、合并症与关键缺失资料
title.en: Review presentation, comorbidities and key missing data

hint.zh-CN: 询问主诉、既往病史及过敏资料，保留未记录项。
hint.en: Ask about the presentation, medical history and allergies; preserve missing information.

guidance.zh-CN: 询问主诉、既往病史及过敏资料，保留未记录项。
guidance.en: Ask about the presentation, medical history and allergies; preserve missing information.

title.zh-CN: 完成检查与影像资料核对

hint.zh-CN: 核对查体记录与现有报告，再作判断。
hint.en: Review examination and existing reports before deciding.

guidance.zh-CN: 核对查体记录与现有报告，再作判断。
guidance.en: Review examination and existing reports before deciding.

hint.zh-CN: 先说清楚证据支持什么诊断、器官在哪一侧，再定个体化计划。
hint.en: State what diagnosis the evidence supports and which side the organs are on, then make an individualised plan.

hint.zh-CN: 弄清楚高龄、慢阻肺与卒中带来的风险，再做麻醉前核对、诱导和切皮前暂停核对。
hint.en: Clarify the risks of age, COPD and stroke, then the Sign In, induction and the Time Out.

hint.zh-CN: 布孔、牵拉、解剖到真正的关键安全视野，再夹闭离断；做不到就选择安全的替代方式。结束后离室核对。
hint.en: Ports, traction, dissection to a true critical view of safety, then clips and division — or a safe alternative if it cannot be reached. Then the Sign Out.

hint.zh-CN: 交接恢复室、定观察重点，再回看原报告的手术、病理和随访。
hint.en: Hand over in recovery, set what to watch, then review the reported operation, histology and follow-up.

prompt.zh-CN: 依据现有资料，最站得住的诊断表述是什么？
prompt.en: On the evidence available, which diagnostic statement holds best?

need.zh-CN: 先查阅超声、化验并检查Murphy征。
need.en: Review the ultrasound and laboratory records and check Murphy's sign first.

text.zh-CN: 胆囊结石，伴疑似（未确诊）急性胆囊炎
text.en: Gallstone disease with suspected, not confirmed, acute cholecystitis

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。东京指南2018：有上腹压痛和发热病史，但查体体温正常、Murphy征阴性、化验概述正常，超声只记载泥沙样结石，局部、全身和影像三项不能同时成立——是胆囊结石伴疑似急性胆囊炎，证据不完整。
feedback.en: Correct. Tokyo Guidelines 2018: upper abdominal tenderness and a reported fever, but a normal temperature at examination, a negative Murphy sign, laboratory results summarised as normal and an ultrasound that records only sludge-like stones — the local, systemic and imaging criteria do not all hold. Gallstone disease with suspected acute cholecystitis; the evidence is incomplete.

text.zh-CN: 确诊急性胆囊炎
text.en: Confirmed acute cholecystitis

feedback.zh-CN: 确诊需要局部征象、全身炎症表现和典型影像同时存在；本例影像未记载胆囊壁增厚等炎症征象，化验概述正常。
feedback.en: A definite diagnosis needs local signs, systemic inflammation and characteristic imaging together; here the imaging records no inflammatory signs and the laboratory summary is normal.

text.zh-CN: 胆总管结石
text.en: Common bile duct stones

feedback.zh-CN: 没有胆管扩张、黄疸或肝功能异常的记载；术中所见胆总管不扩张属于后来的记录。不能据此诊断胆总管结石。
feedback.en: No dilated duct, jaundice or abnormal liver tests is recorded (the undilated common bile duct at operation is a later record); a common bile duct stone is not supported.

text.zh-CN: 胃病，无需关注胆囊
text.en: Gastric disease; the gallbladder is incidental

feedback.zh-CN: 内脏反位的胆道疾病常以左上腹痛就诊而被误认为胃病；本例影像已显示结石。
feedback.en: Biliary disease in situs inversus often presents as left upper abdominal pain mistaken for gastric disease; here imaging shows the stones.

prompt.zh-CN: 根据已取得的影像资料，应如何记录脏器位置？
prompt.en: How should the documented organ positions be recorded?

need.zh-CN: 先取得并阅读影像资料。
need.en: Obtain and read the imaging record first.

text.zh-CN: 肝胆左侧、胃脾右侧，并明确记录解剖反位。
text.en: Liver/gallbladder left, stomach/spleen right; explicitly document inversion.

feedback.zh-CN: 与CT记录一致。必须按患者的解剖位置进行核对。
feedback.en: Matches the CT record; confirm the patient-specific anatomy.

text.zh-CN: 按通常位置记录肝胆在右侧。
text.en: Record the usual right-sided liver and gallbladder.

feedback.zh-CN: 忽略了本例已经提供的影像证据。
feedback.en: This disregards the supplied imaging evidence.

text.zh-CN: 已经阅读CT，但仍记录为完全未知。
text.en: Record all positions as unknown despite reading CT.

feedback.zh-CN: 对于原文明确记录的左右位置，应准确记录；未知仅适用于未记载事项。
feedback.en: Explicitly recorded laterality is known; reserve unknown for unrecorded facts.

prompt.zh-CN: 准备术前团队讨论时，哪一种计划最符合本例证据边界？
prompt.en: Which plan respects the evidence boundaries for the preoperative team discussion?

need.zh-CN: 先核实既往病史、过敏资料和影像位置。
need.en: Review comorbidities, allergy information and imaging first.

text.zh-CN: 提示高龄、合并症及反位；由团队结合影像、术者经验确定站位和布局，补核缺失资料。
text.en: Flag age, comorbidities and inversion; the team individualises positioning/layout using imaging and experience, and verifies missing information.

feedback.zh-CN: 原报告讨论承认站位与布孔并无唯一模式；本样例不把作者采用的布孔方式当作唯一标准。
feedback.en: The source discusses more than one positioning/port approach; its particular choice is not the sole accepted standard.

text.zh-CN: 对所有反位患者强制采用一个固定站位和布孔方案。
text.en: Require one fixed positioning and port layout for every patient with inversion.

feedback.zh-CN: 将个案做法推广为普遍规则，超出了原文支持范围。
feedback.en: Generalising one report into a universal rule exceeds the evidence.

text.zh-CN: 未记录的过敏和用药一律补成无异常。
text.en: Fill unrecorded allergies and medicines in as normal or absent.

feedback.zh-CN: 缺失信息不等于阴性结果，需要另行核实。
feedback.en: Missing information is not a negative finding and needs verification.

prompt.zh-CN: 进入历史手术记录回看前，应采用哪项安全原则？
prompt.en: Which safety principle should precede the historical operation review?

need.zh-CN: 先完成团队计划并查阅现有术前资料。
need.en: Complete the team plan and review available preoperative records first.

text.zh-CN: 核对患者、拟行操作和解剖侧别；不因镜像经验而省略结构辨认，不确定时暂停并寻求协助。
text.en: Confirm patient, planned procedure and anatomical laterality; identify structures and pause for help when uncertain.

feedback.zh-CN: WHO要求团队暂停核对患者、操作及部位；SAGES强调解剖辨认与不确定时的安全策略。本项为教学规则，非原报告已执行事项。
feedback.en: WHO calls for team verification; SAGES emphasises anatomical identification and safe responses to uncertainty. This is an authored teaching rule, not a claim about what the report documents.

text.zh-CN: 只凭通常位置和外观直接处理管状结构。
text.en: Act on tubular structures using usual position and appearance alone.

feedback.zh-CN: 既不尊重反位证据，也未完成解剖辨认。
feedback.en: This ignores inversion and omits anatomical identification.

text.zh-CN: 因原文概述检验正常，就宣布已经完成全部麻醉风险评估。
text.en: Treat the normal laboratory summary as completed anaesthetic clearance.

feedback.zh-CN: 原文未给出完整麻醉评估、禁食、气道及用药资料。
feedback.en: A full anaesthetic assessment, fasting, airway and medication record are not supplied.

prompt.zh-CN: 这份病例的结局能支持怎样的表述？
prompt.en: What outcome statement is supported by this report?

need.zh-CN: 进入回看阶段后阅读病理与随访记录。
need.en: Read histology and follow-up in the review phase.

text.zh-CN: 本例1个月随访恢复良好；不能据此估计长期结局或普遍手术成功率。
text.en: Recovery was good at one month in this case; long-term outcome and population success rates cannot be inferred.

feedback.zh-CN: 保持个案结局、随访时长和外推边界。
feedback.en: Preserve the case-level outcome, follow-up duration and limits of inference.

text.zh-CN: 本模拟器证明同类患者手术都能成功。
text.en: The simulator proves surgery succeeds in all similar patients.

feedback.zh-CN: 单例报告与脚本执行均不能证明普遍疗效。
feedback.en: Neither a single report nor a scripted simulation establishes general efficacy.

prompt.zh-CN: 麻醉和手术前，哪些问题必须先弄清楚或做好准备？（多选）
prompt.en: Before anaesthesia and surgery, what must be clarified or prepared? (select all that apply)

need.zh-CN: 先了解既往病史并完成个体化计划。
need.en: Take the medical history and make the individualised plan first.

text.zh-CN: 慢阻肺的现状与通气风险
text.en: COPD status and ventilatory risk

feedback.zh-CN: 84岁慢阻肺患者要评估呼吸症状、用药、近期加重；气腹和全麻会加重通气负担。
feedback.en: An 84-year-old with COPD needs symptoms, medication and recent exacerbations assessed; pneumoperitoneum and general anaesthesia add to the ventilatory load.

text.zh-CN: 抗血小板/抗凝药
text.en: Antiplatelet or anticoagulant therapy

feedback.zh-CN: 脑梗死后可能在用抗血小板或抗凝药；病例未记录，须核实并按出血/血栓风险决定是否停用。
feedback.en: After a stroke he may take antiplatelets or anticoagulants; the case does not say — verify and decide on interruption by bleeding and thrombotic risk.

text.zh-CN: 神经功能后遗症、吞咽与活动能力
text.en: Residual neurological deficit, swallowing and mobility

feedback.zh-CN: 既往卒中后的后遗症、吞咽与活动能力影响误吸风险和术后康复。
feedback.en: Residual stroke deficits, swallowing and mobility affect aspiration risk and recovery.

text.zh-CN: 右位心对监护和除颤的影响
text.en: What dextrocardia means for monitoring and defibrillation

feedback.zh-CN: 右位心：心电图胸导联与除颤电极要按镜像位置放置。
feedback.en: Dextrocardia: ECG chest leads and defibrillator pads go in mirror positions.

text.zh-CN: 根据现有记录直接定ASA分级
text.en: Assign an ASA class from the record as it stands

feedback.zh-CN: 病例没有ASA分级、肺功能或心功能资料，不能凭年龄和诊断名称补出分级。
feedback.en: The case gives no ASA class, lung or cardiac function; a class cannot be filled in from age and diagnoses.

text.zh-CN: 慢阻肺禁止腹腔镜手术
text.en: COPD rules out laparoscopy

feedback.zh-CN: 慢阻肺不是腹腔镜手术的绝对禁忌；需要的是评估和较低气腹压等调整。
feedback.en: COPD does not rule out laparoscopy; it calls for assessment and adjustments such as lower insufflation pressure.

prompt.zh-CN: 转入恢复室后，本例最需要重点观察什么？（多选）
prompt.en: In recovery, what matters most to watch in this patient? (select all that apply)

text.zh-CN: 呼吸与氧合
text.en: Breathing and oxygenation

feedback.zh-CN: 高龄慢阻肺：氧合、呼吸频率、二氧化碳潴留与咳痰能力。
feedback.en: Old age and COPD: oxygenation, respiratory rate, CO₂ retention and ability to cough.

text.zh-CN: 意识与新发神经体征
text.en: Consciousness and new neurological signs

feedback.zh-CN: 既往卒中：术后谵妄与新发神经功能缺损要及时识别。
feedback.en: Previous stroke: recognise delirium and any new neurological deficit early.

text.zh-CN: 胆漏与胆管损伤的征象
text.en: Signs of bile leak or bile duct injury

feedback.zh-CN: 胆漏或胆管损伤可在术后才表现：腹痛加重、发热、黄疸、引流或伤口胆汁。
feedback.en: A bile leak or duct injury may show only after surgery: worsening pain, fever, jaundice, bile in a drain or wound.

text.zh-CN: 出血征象
text.en: Signs of bleeding

feedback.zh-CN: 心率加快、血压下降、腹胀提示出血。
feedback.en: A rising heart rate, falling blood pressure or distension suggest bleeding.

text.zh-CN: 常规当日出院
text.en: Routine same-day discharge

feedback.zh-CN: 高龄合并症患者，原报告术后第5天出院；不能把当日出院当成常规。
feedback.en: An elderly patient with comorbidity; the source reports discharge on day 5 — same-day discharge is not the default here.

text.zh-CN: 询问主诉与病程
text.en: Presenting complaint and duration

text.zh-CN: 询问既往病史
text.en: Past medical history

text.zh-CN: 询问过敏史（未记录即为未知）
text.en: Allergies (unrecorded means unknown)

text.zh-CN: 查心尖搏动与腹部
text.en: Apex beat and abdomen examined

text.zh-CN: 诊断表述与证据相符（疑似而非确诊）
text.en: Diagnosis matches the evidence (suspected, not confirmed)

text.zh-CN: 查阅CT
text.en: CT reviewed

text.zh-CN: 查阅超声
text.en: Ultrasound reviewed

text.zh-CN: 查阅化验
text.en: Laboratory record reviewed

text.zh-CN: 个体化计划
text.en: Individualised plan

text.zh-CN: 围术期风险问题找全
text.en: Perioperative risks identified

text.zh-CN: 正确判断器官侧别
text.en: Laterality identified correctly

text.zh-CN: 诱导前完成麻醉前核对
text.en: Sign In before induction

text.zh-CN: 切皮前暂停核对（在诱导之后、切皮之前）
text.en: Time Out before incision (after induction)

text.zh-CN: 选择能到达左侧胆囊三角的布孔
text.en: A port plan that works the left-sided triangle

text.zh-CN: 向患者左侧（外侧）牵拉胆囊颈，打开三角
text.en: Neck retracted towards the patient's left to open the triangle

text.zh-CN: 坚持先核实再离断的原则
text.en: Verify-before-dividing principle

text.zh-CN: 真实建立并记录关键安全视野后才夹闭
text.en: A true critical view of safety documented before clipping

text.zh-CN: 正确辨认胆囊管与胆囊动脉
text.en: Cystic duct and cystic artery identified correctly

text.zh-CN: 没有在未确认解剖时做不可逆操作
text.en: No irreversible step on unconfirmed anatomy

text.zh-CN: 能量器械未在显露不足处靠近隐藏结构
text.en: No energy near hidden structures in a poorly exposed field

text.zh-CN: 牵拉力度适当，胆囊未撕破
text.en: Gentle traction, gallbladder not torn

text.zh-CN: 胆囊管与胆囊动脉可靠夹闭后再离断
text.en: Cystic duct and artery secured before division

text.zh-CN: 标本装袋经脐孔取出，或选择了替代方式
text.en: Specimen bagged and removed, or an alternative chosen

text.zh-CN: 器械很少相互碰撞
text.en: Few instrument clashes

text.zh-CN: 发生的损伤被及时说出
text.en: Any injury recognised aloud

text.zh-CN: 出血得到控制
text.en: Bleeding controlled

text.zh-CN: 溢出的胆汁和结石已吸净
text.en: Spilled bile and stones cleared

text.zh-CN: 手术结束后、离室前核对
text.en: Sign Out after the operation, before leaving

text.zh-CN: 术后观察重点
text.en: Postoperative priorities

text.zh-CN: 回看手术与病理记录
text.en: Operation and histology records reviewed

text.zh-CN: 正确界定单例结局的意义
text.en: Single-case outcome bounded correctly

text.zh-CN: 发现并可靠处理第二支胆囊动脉
text.en: The second (posterior) cystic artery found and secured

text.zh-CN: 保留绕入三角的肝右动脉，处理其发出的短胆囊动脉
text.en: The right hepatic artery looping into the triangle preserved; its short cystic branch secured

text.zh-CN: 穿过三角的迷走胆管未被夹闭或离断
text.en: The aberrant duct crossing the triangle left intact

text.zh-CN: 在致密纤维化处停止分离，改行胆囊次全切除或中转开腹
text.en: Stopped at the safe plane in dense fibrosis and chose a subtotal cholecystectomy or conversion

text.zh-CN: 胆囊床内的胆囊下胆管在剥离完成前已夹闭
text.en: The subvesical duct in the bed clipped before the dissection was completed

knowledge.zh-CN: 协助核对现有记录；未记录的过敏、禁食和用药不能补写。
knowledge.en: Help review available records; do not invent allergy, fasting or medication information.

knowledge.zh-CN: 只解释学员已经阅读的影像报告；没有原始DICOM，不能声称完成患者级三维重建。
knowledge.en: Interpret only imaging reports already read; without original DICOM, do not claim patient-specific 3D reconstruction.

knowledge.zh-CN: 引导学员区分来源事实与教学规则，并说明证据局限。
knowledge.en: Guide the learner to distinguish source facts from teaching rules and explain evidence limits.

knowledge.zh-CN: 负责麻醉前核对、诱导、通气与监护。知道慢阻肺患者在气腹下易有二氧化碳潴留，常用较低气腹压；病例未记录肺功能、ASA分级与用药，需当场核实。不解释手术解剖。
knowledge.en: Runs the Sign In, induction, ventilation and monitoring. Knows that COPD patients retain CO₂ under pneumoperitoneum and that lower pressures are often used; the case records no lung function, ASA class or medicines — these are verified now. Does not interpret surgical anatomy.

conclusion.zh-CN: 全内脏反位合并胆囊结石：现有证据支持胆囊结石伴疑似急性胆囊炎（东京指南2018），手术在镜像解剖中完成。模拟中的手术在参考解剖上进行，只有真实建立关键安全视野才算安全；原报告的结局不由模拟决定。
conclusion.en: Situs inversus totalis with gallstones: the evidence supports gallstone disease with suspected acute cholecystitis (Tokyo Guidelines 2018), operated on in mirror-image anatomy. The simulated operation runs on reference anatomy and counts as safe only with a true critical view of safety; the reported outcome is not decided by the simulation.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 诊断以证据为限：发热史、压痛与结石不等于确诊急性胆囊炎。
keyReasoning.en: Diagnosis stays within the evidence: a history of fever, tenderness and stones are not a confirmed acute cholecystitis.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: CT明确记载左右位置；原文未记载的事项保持未知。
keyReasoning.en: CT explicitly records laterality; unrecorded items remain unknown.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 作者采用的站位和三孔法不是所有患者的唯一标准。
keyReasoning.en: The authors' positioning and three-port approach are not the sole standard for all patients.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 术后资料仅在完成前置阶段后开放；结局来自报告，而非干预效果模型。
keyReasoning.en: Later records open after prerequisites; outcomes come from the report, not a treatment-effect model.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 镜像解剖中，三角的显露靠把胆囊颈向患者左侧牵拉；沿用常规（向右）牵拉会关闭三角，并让胆总管看起来像汇入胆囊颈。
keyReasoning.en: In mirror-image anatomy the triangle opens by pulling the neck towards the patient's left; the habitual pull to the right closes it and makes the common bile duct look as if it runs into the gallbladder neck.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 关键安全视野由术野判定，而非勾选：三角清空、胆囊板可见、只有两根结构进入胆囊。
keyReasoning.en: The critical view of safety is judged on the field, not by ticking: triangle cleared, cystic plate seen, two and only two structures entering the gallbladder.

boundaries.zh-CN: 三维解剖为参考解剖（BodyParts3D与Layered Human程序化模型），不是患者CT重建；组织力学为状态模型，未经标定；术中生命体征为模拟值，未经临床标定；评分为教学流程检查，未经效度验证，也不是GOALS评分；未经外科、麻醉或影像专家审核。
boundaries.en: The 3D anatomy is reference anatomy (BodyParts3D and the Layered Human procedural model), not a CT reconstruction of the patient; tissue behaviour is a state model, not calibrated mechanics; intra-operative vital signs are simulated and uncalibrated; the score checks an authored workflow — it is not validated and is not a GOALS score; no surgical, anaesthetic or radiological expert has reviewed it.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: WHO 2009：切皮前团队共同核对患者、操作及部位。
teachingPoints.en: WHO 2009: the team verifies patient, procedure and site before incision.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: SAGES 2020：重视解剖辨认；解剖不确定时采用安全策略并寻求协助。
teachingPoints.en: SAGES 2020: prioritise anatomical identification and safe strategies/help when anatomy is uncertain.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 缺失资料不能补成阴性；病历中的概述正常不能变成虚构数值。
teachingPoints.en: Missing data are not negative findings; a normal summary does not supply numerical results.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 单例短期良好结局不等于普遍成功率。
teachingPoints.en: A favourable short-term outcome in one case is not a population success rate.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: SAGES 2020：建立关键安全视野；无法建立时采用暂停、求助、术中胆道影像、胆囊次全切除或中转开腹等策略。
teachingPoints.en: SAGES 2020: achieve the critical view of safety; when it cannot be achieved, stop, call for help, image the bile ducts, or choose a subtotal cholecystectomy or conversion.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 东京指南2018：确诊急性胆囊炎需要局部征象、全身炎症和影像三者兼备。
teachingPoints.en: Tokyo Guidelines 2018: a definite acute cholecystitis needs local signs, systemic inflammation and imaging together.

references: 张少博, 余仁斌. 内脏完全反位腹腔镜胆囊切除术一例. 肝胆胰外科杂志. 2024;36(3):180-181.
World Health Organization. Implementation manual WHO surgical safety checklist 2009. Geneva: WHO; 2009. https://www.who.int/publications/i/item/9789241598590
SAGES. Safe Cholecystectomy Multi-Society Practice Guideline. 2020. https://www.sages.org/publications/guidelines/safe-cholecystectomy-multi-society-practice-guideline/
Yokoe M, Hata J, Takada T, et al. Tokyo Guidelines 2018: diagnostic criteria and severity grading of acute cholecystitis (with videos). J Hepatobiliary Pancreat Sci. 2018;25(1):41-54.

Brunt LM, Deziel DJ, Telem DA, et al. Safe cholecystectomy multi-society practice guideline and state-of-the-art consensus conference on prevention of bile duct injury during cholecystectomy. Surg Endosc. 2020;34(7):2827-2855.
Strasberg SM, Hertl M, Soper NJ. An analysis of the problem of biliary injury during laparoscopic cholecystectomy. J Am Coll Surg. 1995;180(1):101-125.

notice.zh-CN: 技术样例的流程评分，非已验证的医疗能力评分；真实模型性能尚未测量。
notice.en: Technical demonstration workflow score, not validated clinical competence; live-model performance has not been measured.

unknowns.zh-CN: 原报告没有记录，不能据此认定正常或不存在。
unknowns.en: Not recorded in the source; this does not establish normality or absence.

unknowns.zh-CN: 体重、SpO₂、药物、剂量、过敏、禁食、气道评估、详细检验数值及长期随访未记录。
unknowns.en: Weight, SpO₂, medicines, doses, allergies, fasting, airway assessment, detailed laboratory values and long-term follow-up are not recorded.

unknowns.zh-CN: 患者个体的胆管与血管走行：原报告只写“未发现血管解剖变异”，未给出胆囊管汇入方式或胆囊动脉来源。
unknowns.en: The patient's own ductal and arterial anatomy: the source says only that no vascular variation was found; it does not give the cystic duct's insertion or the cystic artery's origin.

unknowns.zh-CN: ASA分级、肺功能、血气、心电图、用药（含抗血小板/抗凝药）、气道评估、麻醉方式细节。
unknowns.en: ASA class, lung function, blood gases, ECG, medicines (including antiplatelets or anticoagulants), airway assessment and anaesthetic details.

unknowns.zh-CN: 标本取出方式、器械规格（除报告的Trocar尺寸外）、气腹压力、出血量的具体数值。
unknowns.en: How the specimen was removed, instrument sizes beyond the reported trocars, insufflation pressure and a measured blood loss.

summary.zh-CN: 除胆囊三角内的胆囊动脉（前支）外，另有一支后支自肝右动脉发出，沿胆囊板走到胆囊后壁，并穿过胆囊床。关键安全视野要求它也游离可见；只处理两根结构即离断，完成胆囊床剥离时会撕断后支而出血。
summary.en: Besides the cystic artery in the triangle (the anterior branch), a posterior branch leaves the right hepatic artery, runs on the cystic plate to the back of the gallbladder and crosses the bed. The critical view needs it free and seen too; dividing only two structures leaves it to be torn, and bleed, when the bed is completed.

references: Andall RG, Matusz P, du Plessis M, Ward R, Tubbs RS, Loukas M. The clinical anatomy of cystic artery variations: a review of over 9800 cases. Surg Radiol Anat. 2016;38(5):529-539.

Brunt LM, Deziel DJ, Telem DA, et al. Safe cholecystectomy multi-society practice guideline and state-of-the-art consensus conference on prevention of bile duct injury during cholecystectomy. Surg Endosc. 2020;34(7):2827-2855.

name.en: Caterpillar hump of the right hepatic artery

summary.zh-CN: 肝右动脉迂曲成袢进入胆囊三角，紧贴胆囊颈，再折回肝门；胆囊动脉很短，自袢顶发出。三角未完全清空前，这根动脉看起来像进入胆囊颈的血管；把它当作胆囊动脉夹闭即为血管损伤。
summary.en: The right hepatic artery loops into the triangle close to the gallbladder neck and turns back to the hilum; the cystic artery is short and leaves the top of the loop. Until the triangle is fully cleared the loop looks like a vessel entering the neck; clipping it as the cystic artery is a vascular injury.

references: Marano L, Bartoli A, Polom K, et al. The unwanted third wheel in the Calot's triangle: incidence and surgical significance of caterpillar hump of right hepatic artery with a systematic review of the literature. J Minim Access Surg. 2019;15(3):185-191.
Andall RG, Matusz P, du Plessis M, Ward R, Tubbs RS, Loukas M. The clinical anatomy of cystic artery variations: a review of over 9800 cases. Surg Radiol Anat. 2016;38(5):529-539.

summary.zh-CN: 右后叶胆管单独穿过胆囊三角，在胆囊管汇合处附近低位汇入肝总管。三角未完全清空前，它看起来像进入胆囊颈后方的第三根管道；把它当作胆囊管夹闭或离断即为胆管损伤（Strasberg B/C型）。
summary.en: The right posterior sectoral duct crosses the triangle on its own and joins the common hepatic duct low, near the cystic confluence. Until the triangle is fully cleared it looks like a third duct entering the back of the neck; clipping or dividing it as the cystic duct is a bile duct injury (Strasberg type B or C).

references: Strasberg SM, Hertl M, Soper NJ. An analysis of the problem of biliary injury during laparoscopic cholecystectomy. J Am Coll Surg. 1995;180(1):101-125.

Brunt LM, Deziel DJ, Telem DA, et al. Safe cholecystectomy multi-society practice guideline and state-of-the-art consensus conference on prevention of bile duct injury during cholecystectomy. Surg Endosc. 2020;34(7):2827-2855.

default.en: a duct about 2 mm across coming out of the liver behind the gallbladder neck and running down to the common duct

text.zh-CN: 一根细小的管道，似乎进入胆囊颈后方
text.en: a small duct that seems to run into the back of the gallbladder neck

name.zh-CN: 胆囊三角致密纤维化（“冰冻”三角）
name.en: Dense fibrosis of the triangle (a "frozen" triangle)

summary.zh-CN: 严重慢性炎症使胆囊三角致密纤维化：解剖到一半层次就分不开，关键安全视野无法安全建立。继续分离会撕裂胆总管；正确的做法是停下来，选择胆囊次全切除（开窗式或重建式）或中转开腹。与原报告（无粘连）相反，属于假设情境。
summary.en: Severe chronic inflammation has left the triangle densely fibrotic: halfway through, the planes stop separating and the critical view cannot be reached safely. Dissecting on tears the common bile duct; the right course is to stop and choose a subtotal cholecystectomy (fenestrating or reconstituting) or conversion. Counterfactual: the report found no adhesions.

references: Wakabayashi G, Iwashita Y, Hibi T, et al. Tokyo Guidelines 2018: surgical management of acute cholecystitis: safe steps in laparoscopic cholecystectomy for acute cholecystitis (with videos). J Hepatobiliary Pancreat Sci. 2018;25(1):73-86.

Strasberg SM, Pucci MJ, Brunt LM, Deziel DJ. Subtotal cholecystectomy - "fenestrating" vs "reconstituting" subtypes and the prevention of bile duct injury: definition of the optimal procedure in difficult operative conditions. J Am Coll Surg. 2016;222(1):89-96.

Brunt LM, Deziel DJ, Telem DA, et al. Safe cholecystectomy multi-society practice guideline and state-of-the-art consensus conference on prevention of bile duct injury during cholecystectomy. Surg Endosc. 2020;34(7):2827-2855.

finding.zh-CN: 致密、质硬的纤维化组织：层次分不开，任何结构都无法安全游离
finding.en: dense, woody fibrosis: the tissue planes do not separate and nothing can be freed safely

name.zh-CN: 胆囊床内的胆囊下胆管
name.en: A subvesical duct in the gallbladder bed

summary.zh-CN: 一根细小的胆囊下胆管（旧称Luschka管）在胆囊床内紧贴肝面走行，汇入右肝管系统。它不进入胆囊，不影响关键安全视野；剥离胆囊床时出现后应先夹闭，否则完成剥离会把它撕断，造成胆漏。
summary.en: A fine subvesical duct (formerly "duct of Luschka") runs in the gallbladder bed against the liver and drains into the right hepatic duct system. It does not enter the gallbladder, so the critical view is unaffected; once it appears during the bed dissection it should be clipped, or completing the dissection divides it and bile leaks.

references: Schnelldorfer T, Sarr MG, Adams DB. What is the duct of Luschka? A systematic review. J Gastrointest Surg. 2012;16(3):656-662.

default.zh-CN: 胆囊床内一根很细的管道，紧贴肝面
default.en: a fine duct running in the gallbladder bed, close to the liver surface
